scope: 1647 original UNNUMBERED tenth-house honours introduction; historical source questions and hierarchy only, not career/status forecasts
first_edition_source: William Lilly Christian Astrology original first edition Wellcome b30338724

source_groups.topic: Unnumbered tenth house and ranked luminary-first honors indicators

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: The tenth House and the Judgments thereunto appertaining
claims.historical_source_meaning_only: A separately headed, substantive UNNUMBERED tenth-house introduction occurs before printed CXLIIII.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Of the Honours or Dignities of the Native
claims.historical_source_meaning_only: The section defines its topic as status and distinction, not general psychological traits.
The author includes honours as one historical social-status target.
Office or advancement is listed separately from fame and title.
Social dignity is an additional named status outcome in the source.
Public estimation or regard is another historical outcome rather than a quantified measure.
The author makes Sun and Moon the first-ranked class of testimony for honours.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: wherein the Sun is most considerable
claims.historical_source_meaning_only: Sun receives special priority even within the luminary class.
Other planets contribute as secondary aspecting testimony to the luminaries.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: within the mediety of their Orbes
claims.historical_source_meaning_only: Those aspecting planets must be within source half-orb limit, not any arbitrary aspect.
The author singles out planets aspecting Sun as most salient for this additional class.

source_groups.topic: Second through fourth ranked midheaven and bright-star sources

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Secondly from Lord of the mid heaven
claims.historical_source_meaning_only: Lord/ruler of the Midheaven is the second-ranked source of dignities.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Thirdly Planet or Planets constituted in the mid-heaven
claims.historical_source_meaning_only: Planets occupying the Midheaven form a third-ranked distinct indicator.
Fixed stars of the regal class provide fourth-ranked possible testimony.
Only first- or second-magnitude stars are specified, not every visible fixed star.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: posited neer the cusps of tenth
claims.historical_source_meaning_only: One allowed location is near the cusp of the tenth house.
The ascendant/first-house cusp is a separate allowed position for regal stars.
